summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, per-function string-lookup objects) and, at install time, detects glibc vs musl, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then runs execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js']) against a bundled ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (string-array shuffle, giant hex/letter constant array, custom string decoder). This alternate-runtime-dropper shape executes opaque bundled code on the installer's machine at npm install time under a freshly-downloaded JS engine that Node-based supply-chain scanners typically do not inspect. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library; the React UI code paths do not reference math_init.js, and a UI library has no legitimate need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute an obfuscated non-UI payload during installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
